vnStat re-imports can repair supported history gaps and refresh the selected range while preserving live observations and unrelated history. Missing interfaces and unreconcilable fragments now preserve existing data and complete successfully. Repeated imports avoid unnecessary rewrites and duplicate accounting.

Interface selection supports prefixes such as `e*`, now the default for new frontend import drafts. The Network dispatch form also has a more compact layout.

Update the server, frontend, CLI and agents together; vnStat import commands now require protocol 10. No new database migration is required.
